items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: I played in the Jackson band then.

ctx.x: Well when you were a kid, did you follow any drummers around or anything?

Never just follow no parades when I was a kid. Never follow no parades around. Just go and look at them. See on Conville Day, hardly go and see Conville parades. I don't like to be in the monster gang of people. Never do. Can't stand to be amongst the crowd. Right now, when I'm working now at the hospital, the crowd go up on the elevator, I let them go up and I catch the next elevator. I never liked it from a kid up, never liked to be in the crowd. I used to go to theaters. Sometimes they had the, when they had…
Made that fella shame, that dog farm.

items.title: Crescent City Crystals: Dave Bailey, Harold Christophe, Albert Delone, Sylvester Handy Interview, 1963-11-13
items.q: I worked with, uh, that's the only two brass bands I worked with. No, three. Yeah. A fellow named Jimmy Jackson, he died.

ctx.x: I worked with Stutter. What brass bands, what brass bands you worked with?
I worked with, uh, that's the only two brass bands I worked with. No, three. Yeah. A fellow named Jimmy Jackson, he died. Uh-huh.
What instrument did he play? Well, he used to play snare drum.
